Quick heads up: the US switches to daylight savings time on Sun 8 Mar, which means US wall-clock times will shift an hour starting that weekend (we'll be on EDT/PDT depending on the coast). That can cause confusion for cross-region invites if people are referencing older time slots.

To avoid forcing APAC people into after-midnight attendance, can I propose two alternatives that should be friendly across regions:

Option A: Tue 9 Mar, 11:00 AM PDT / Tue 9 Mar, 07:00 PM GMT / Tue 9 Mar, 11:00 PM SGT (later APAC)
Option B: Wed 10 Mar, 08:00 AM PDT / Wed 10 Mar, 04:00 PM GMT / Thu 11 Mar, 12:00 AM SGT (still late for Singapore)

If neither of those works, we can push to Thu 11 Mar to get a window that hits APAC morning and US late-night (I know not ideal).

I've attached a short agenda so you can confirm focus areas.

Best,
